status: evidence registry for a pre-feasibility USD envelope; optimizer remains on planning credits

fx.source_title: Tasa de cambio representativa del mercado (TRM)
fx.comparability_warning: A single TRM date makes the envelope reproducible. It is not a procurement FX clause.

cpi.source: DANE, Índice de Precios al Consumidor (IPC)
cpi.source_title: IPC — variación anual y factores de actualización usados para normalizar presupuestos a julio 2026
cpi.method: Chain official annual IPC factors onto the source-year amount, then apply the January–July 2026 factor.
inclusions: National IPC chain used only to place historical household-equipment COP budgets on a July 2026 price date
cpi.comparability_warning: National IPC updates household RWH equipment only. Civil works use ICOCIV.

icociv.source: DANE, Índice de Costos de la Construcción de Obras Civiles (ICOCIV)
icociv.source_title: ICOCIV — variación anual diciembre, base diciembre 2020 = 100
icociv.method: Chain official December/December ICOCIV factors. The series begins December 2020 = 100, so a 2019 amount uses a one-year IPC bridge to 2020. No 2026 ICOCIV year-to-date factor is applied because no official bulletin for that window is in this registry.
inclusions: Official ICOCIV annual variation used to place 2019 civil-works COP on a December 2025 price level
icociv.comparability_warning: ICOCIV is the civil-works inflator. It is not a transferable unit price and does not replace a site BOQ.

design_allowance.source_title: Design Well, Build Better: A Guide for Planning, Creating, Overseeing and Making Decisions about Social Infrastructure Designs
design_allowance.quantity_basis: design as a share of construction, not a lump sum
inclusions: Pre-feasibility design allowance used until a 30% design exists
design_allowance.comparability_warning: IDB design-share guidance is not a Medellín fee schedule. It is a later pricing method for the unpriced 30% design ask, not a present lump sum.

drainage_corridor_length_m.note: Planning-cell width is 80 m. Corridor length is not surveyed; these are named pre-feasibility length scenarios, not geometry.

rwh_usd_per_system.note: Planning range around the 2026-normalized Santa Elena ceiling. Not an awarded Comuna 8 price.

restoration_usd_per_package.note: Conceptual project-scale range around the ICOCIV- and TRM-normalized DAGRD Comuna 8 package. Not a USD/m² rate.

references.inflation_method: Chain DANE IPC 2024, 2025 and January–July 2026 onto the 2023 ceiling
references.fx_method: Divide July-2026 COP by Banco de la República TRM 2026-08-28
inclusions: tank, connections, support, transport, installation, practical training and warranty
